item.title: An explosion at a middle school in eastern Afghanistan kills or wounds several students
item.description: An explosion at a middle school in Afghanistan's Kunar province has killed or wounded several students. Police in the province reported the incident on Saturday.

item.title: Zapatistas begin a 'Tour for Life' from Chiapas to Mexico City to meet with families of disappeared
item.description: More than 1,500 members of Mexico’s Zapatista movement will travel from the southern state of Chiapas to Mexico City to meet with families of the disappeared and join forces to address the issue of the more than 130,000 people missing across the country.

item.title: Tiny bee hotels open a hidden world of city pollinators in South Africa
item.description: The UrbanBEE project in South Africa is exploring how cities affect bee diversity by recruiting volunteers as citizen scientists.
